es: Planificar contexto, hecho anterior, giro y desenlace.
Escribir un relato conectado de 60–80 palabras.

teaching.en: Set the context with time, place and action.
teaching.es: Presenta el contexto con tiempo, lugar y acción.
teaching.explanationEs: El contexto orienta al lector desde el inicio.
teaching.audioText: Set the context with time, place and action.

teaching.en: Show a previous event with past perfect.
teaching.es: Muestra un hecho anterior con past perfect.
teaching.explanationEs: El hecho previo explica la situación.
teaching.audioText: Show a previous event with past perfect.

teaching.en: Add a turn that changes the story.
teaching.es: Añade un giro que cambie la historia.
teaching.explanationEs: El giro debe afectar lo que sucede después.
teaching.audioText: Add a turn that changes the story.

teaching.en: Give the story a clear outcome.
teaching.es: Da a la historia un desenlace claro.
teaching.explanationEs: El resultado debe resolver o explicar el cambio.
teaching.audioText: Give the story a clear outcome.

teaching.en: Connect the stages, then revise the chronology.
teaching.es: Conecta las etapas y luego revisa la cronología.
teaching.explanationEs: Revisar evita saltos o contradicciones temporales.
teaching.audioText: Connect the stages, then revise the chronology.

prompt.es: Elige el mejor contexto para iniciar una historia.

choices.text: It was a cold morning, and I was waiting outside the college.
Eventually, I found the correct classroom.

feedback.es: La primera opción establece lugar, momento y acción inicial.

hint.es: Un contexto responde cuándo, dónde y qué estaba ocurriendo.

prompt.es: Completa el hecho anterior: I was nervous because I ___.

feedback.es: Had forgotten my notes explica el nerviosismo previo.

hint.es: Usa had más participio y el objeto perdido.

prompt.es: Ordena el giro de la presentación.

answer.text: Suddenly my classmate offered to share her notes.

feedback.es: Suddenly presenta la ayuda que cambia la situación.

hint.es: Comienza con la señal de giro y sigue con sujeto y verbo.

prompt.es: Une las cuatro etapas con datos de una historia.

I had left the repair kit at home
We reached the village before dark

feedback.es: Las cuatro piezas forman una secuencia narrativa completa.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige el detalle que hace coherente el final.

choices.text: The repaired tyre let them continue

feedback.es: La reparación permite continuar y explica la llegada final.

origin.audio: Our tyre was flat, but a mechanic repaired it. Eventually, we reached the village before dark.

prompt.es: Conecta las cuatro etapas del viaje en dos oraciones.

answer.text: It was raining, and we had lost our umbrella. Then a taxi stopped, so we arrived dry.
accepted: It was raining, and we had lost our umbrella. Then a taxi stopped, so we arrived dry.
We had lost our umbrella while it was raining, but a taxi stopped and took us there dry.

feedback.es: Las variantes conectan contexto, antecedente, giro y resultado.

prompt.es: Elige el hecho anterior que explica el hambre de los viajeros.

feedback.es: Had skipped breakfast aporta una causa anterior clara.

prompt.es: Escucha y selecciona el giro de la historia del teléfono.

feedback.es: El hallazgo del corredor cambia la búsqueda y conduce a la solución.

origin.audio: I had dropped my phone on the path. I was searching in the dark when a runner found it.

prompt.es: Ordena el desenlace de la visita inesperada.

answer.text: Eventually we shared dinner and laughed together.

feedback.es: Eventually introduce un cierre explícito y conectado con la visita.

prompt.es: Escribe 60–80 palabras sobre una excursión con un giro.

answer.text: At first, my cousin and I were walking through a wet forest. We were worried because our map had become impossible to read in the rain. Suddenly, a forest ranger appeared on the path and showed us a safer route. Later, we followed the river towards a small shelter. Eventually, we arrived there before dark, made hot tea, and called our family to explain that we were safe.
accepted: At first, my cousin and I were walking through a wet forest. We were worried because our map had become impossible to read in the rain. Suddenly, a forest ranger appeared on the path and showed us a safer route. Later, we followed the river towards a small shelter. Eventually, we arrived there before dark, made hot tea, and called our family to explain that we were safe.

My cousin and I were hiking in a rainy forest when we noticed that the map had become unreadable. We did not know which path to take. Suddenly, a ranger found us and pointed towards a shelter beside the river. Later, we walked there together. Eventually, we reached the shelter before night, drank something warm, and sent our family a message saying that everything was fine.

feedback.es: Las versiones desarrollan las cuatro etapas y mantienen una cronología coherente.

origin.text: Contexto: bosque lluvioso. Antes: mapa mojado. Giro: guardabosques llega. Final: refugio.

prompt.es: ¿Qué final resuelve una historia sobre un tren perdido?

choices.text: At first, we checked the time.
Eventually, we took the next train and arrived at noon.

feedback.es: El siguiente tren y la llegada a mediodía cierran el problema.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada detalle de la fiesta con su etapa.

pairs: I had written the wrong time

feedback.es: La secuencia vincula el error previo con la solución y el inicio de la fiesta.

pairs: I had written the wrong time

prompt.es: Redacta 60–80 palabras sobre una entrega que cambia.

answer.text: At first, I was delivering a birthday parcel on a busy afternoon. I became confused because I had copied one number in the address incorrectly. Suddenly, the customer called and described a bright blue door near the library. Later, I recognised the correct street and found the house. Eventually, I delivered the parcel before the party began, and the customer thanked me for checking instead of leaving it elsewhere.
accepted: At first, I was delivering a birthday parcel on a busy afternoon. I became confused because I had copied one number in the address incorrectly. Suddenly, the customer called and described a bright blue door near the library. Later, I recognised the correct street and found the house. Eventually, I delivered the parcel before the party began, and the customer thanked me for checking instead of leaving it elsewhere.

I was carrying a birthday package through heavy afternoon traffic when I realised that I had written the wrong house number. Suddenly, the customer phoned and mentioned a blue door beside the library. That landmark helped me find the correct road. Later, I reached the house, and eventually I handed over the parcel before the celebration started. The customer was pleased that I had called to confirm the address.

feedback.es: Ambos relatos conectan el error anterior, la llamada decisiva y la entrega final.

origin.text: Contexto: tarde con tráfico. Antes: dirección copiada mal. Giro: cliente llama. Final: entrega.
